title: SIM_COVERAGE.json
description: The simulator coverage map of one course (L66): every leaf Knowledge / Understanding / Proficiency item of the IMO model course's syllabus against the school's simulators, and the simulator tasks proposed for what a simulator can train and the course does not. Lives in course\working_claude\, beside SIM_MAP.md and SIM_COVERAGE.md. Validated by coverage/scripts/sim_coverage.py check, which also checks what a schema cannot: one row per syllabus item, the counts, every GAP in a task, every GAP task drafted.

_what.description: what this file is, the model course and the sources

verdict_meaning.description: the four verdicts in words, for the reader

sim_codes.description: the simulators this course is mapped against: code -> name; codes from coverage/knowledge/simulators.json

competence.description: the competence as the model course names it, its id first (C1 ...)

kup_text.description: the item's words, as the syllabus has them

sim.description: the simulator code(s) that can train it, or "-"

scenario.description: which procedure, scenario or fault trains it

pages.description: manual short name + PDF page ("LNG p62"), and the model course page

covered_by.description: the exercise that does it on the simulator now, or "-"

note.description: why; for NOT-SIM the practical alternative; what must be checked on the installation

id.description: P1, P2 ... ranked, most value first

simulator.description: the code it runs on (and a variant on another, in words)

sub_ilo.description: the Sub-ILO it practises - never a changed ILO

minutes.description: 0 for an inject inside an exercise that already runs

net_sim_minutes.description: simulator minutes the course gains (0 when the minutes move from another simulator part)

old_task.description: the old course's simulator task it renews, if any

minutes_from.description: where the minutes come from inside the module's approved hours

needs.description: what has to be checked on the installation or decided

draft.description: the draft exercise's number (29.1); its forms are in to_review\exercises\sim_drafts\MNN\

old_e_tasks.description: the old course's simulator tasks and where each lives now
